info.title: CacheScope interactive runner API
info.description: Contract for a future local HTTP backend. No server implementation is supplied. Normative lifecycle/cross-field rules: docs/RUNNER_API.md. Existing trace/report artifact schemas remain unchanged.

servers.description: Local backend; the launcher supplies the actual base URL/port.

post.summary: Reserve the single session and start asynchronous preflight

Location.description: Relative path to the new resource, including /api/v1.

post.description: Valid request/configuration reserves the resource and returns preparing. Trace readability and semantic validation happen asynchronously. Failed preparation is reported by GET session as status=failed. Existing sessions of any status must be explicitly deleted first.

get.summary: Discover zero or one current session
Poll status, revision, configuration and negotiated limits
get.description: Available during preparation, execution and failure. During a command returns busy=true with only the last published cursor/revision. Failed session descriptors are successful HTTP 200 responses.

parameters.name: expected_revision
parameters.description: Must match the current published revision. Mismatch returns 409; snapshots from older revisions are not retained.

delete.description: Allowed while preparing (cancels/discards preparation) and in ready/finished/failed. While a synchronous step/reset is running returns session_busy. Revision must match. Successful deletion invalidates the resource; repeated deletion is 404.

get.summary: Read immutable trace, buffer and source-map metadata
get.description: Available in ready/finished, including while a command is busy; unavailable before preparation or after failure. No revision parameter because metadata does not change.

post.summary: Synchronously execute a bounded number of complete trace events
post.description: Available in ready/finished. Serializes with mutations and state/stat reads. Validates count and revision before execution. count beyond remaining events clips at EOF. A nonempty successful batch increments revision once, not once per event. No background continue or partial event visibility.

post.summary: Synchronously restore the same session to its reproducible cold state
post.description: Clears all levels, counters and last_event; restores policy seeds. Increments revision even if already cold. Does not change trace/configuration/layout. Allowed for ready/finished and failed with recovery=reset. Preparing or recovery=recreate returns 409. Empty trace remains finished.

get.summary: Read a physical cache page and cumulative global summary at a revision

parameters.name: expected_revision
parameters.description: Must match the current published revision. Mismatch returns 409; snapshots from older revisions are not retained.

parameters.name: set_limit
parameters.description: At most limits.max_sets_per_read. Offset must be <= set_count; range clips at end.

get.description: Available only when ready/finished and not busy. Snapshot represents final physical occupancy after the last whole event, including exclusive promotions, cascading evictions and dirty changes. Requests for different levels/pages must use the same revision.

get.summary: Read cumulative per-instruction statistics at a revision

parameters.name: expected_revision
parameters.description: Must match the current published revision. Mismatch returns 409; snapshots from older revisions are not retained.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most limits.max_instructions_per_read. Offset must be <= total_instructions; range clips at end.

get.description: Available only when ready/finished and not busy. Every row contains all configured cache levels. Read every page with the same revision; reset/step invalidates previous pages.

UInt64.description: Canonical decimal string, 0..18446744073709551615 inclusive. Range is normative even when a validator ignores this custom format.

Address.description: Unsigned 64-bit model address in canonical lowercase hexadecimal, not a host pointer.

SessionId.description: Opaque identifier, unique for the lifetime of the backend instance and never reused by that instance.

LevelConfig.description: Request configuration. Names must be unique. Capacity must contain full sets; line_size_bytes and derived set_count must be powers of two. All levels have equal line_size_bytes. random_seed is allowed only for Random; omitted seed means 0. Each set gets an independent policy with this seed.

EffectiveLevel.description: Ordered by level, starting at 1. random_seed is the effective seed for Random and null for LRU/FIFO.

Limits.description: Backend-selected positive limits. Example values are not protocol defaults. Clients must read and obey these limits.

trace_path.description: Absolute path in the backend filesystem. The file must remain unchanged until deletion.

ErrorInfo.description: message is human-readable; clients branch on code. details is diagnostic JSON, not a stable typed data source. recovery is present for a failed session: reset allows reset or recreate; recreate allows only delete/create.

ErrorResponse.description: session_id and revision identify the affected resource when known. GET the session to recover current status after an uncertain command result.

Session.description: Immutable trace/configuration; mutable status/cursor/revision. cursor counts fully completed trace events. busy reports an in-flight synchronous command; only the last published cursor/revision is visible. total_events is null until preflight completes. A failed session has error with recovery; other statuses have error=null.

StepRequest.description: count must not exceed limits.max_step_count. A step completes whole events including all line probes and migrations.

path.description: Relative to the original trace directory; metadata only, not an HTTP resource.

SourceMap.description: HTTP projection with string origin IDs. Stage order and all stage/origin relationships are preserved. Optional source-map extension properties are preserved.

Source.description: Normalized HTTP metadata, not an artifact conforming to cachescope.trace.v1. Complete source producer object is retained.

Buffer.description: Preflight layout. Envelope includes offset 0: min_offset<=0, end_offset>=0 (exclusive end). Base is 64-byte aligned. Ranges do not overlap. Same layout after reset.

Metadata.description: Immutable after successful preparation, available in ready/finished. All declared sites, including unexecuted ones; buffers include only referenced memrefs. Accesses and buffers sorted numerically by ID. No source text or source-file endpoint.

TraceEvent.description: Normalized required fields of the input event. Not the raw artifact event; extra input fields are not promised in this DTO.

LineResult.description: Demand probe outcome. On L1 miss, way is the placement way; on a lower-level miss it is null. A lower-level hit way identifies the slot before promotion. L1 eviction fields describe its victim; cascading evictions are in EventOutcome.evictions.

EventOutcome.description: One complete event. Level groups ascending, lines in demand order; untouched levels omitted. Evictions in occurrence order include all cascades. This is not a complete slot mutation journal and must not be used to reconstruct physical cache state.

Totals.description: Local demand probes only; rates are null without probes. Evictions count all actual victims at this level, including migrations. writebacks count dirty victims leaving this level, not just memory writes.

Summary.description: Cumulative statistics for [0,cursor). Root processed/totals equal L1. Every configured level is present, including zero counters. Local hit rates classify original read/write demand; internal transfers are not probes. No flush at EOF.

Progress.description: A coherent published execution boundary. last_event is null at cursor 0, otherwise event sequence cursor-1.

StepResponse.description: All completed outcomes of this successful bounded command, plus final cumulative statistics. executed_count equals events.length. EOF returns 200 with executed_count=0 and unchanged revision. A failed batch returns an error, not a partial successful StepResponse.

CachePage.description: Final physical occupancy, in set/way order. All ways of each returned set are present, including invalid slots. Range clips at end; next_set_offset is null at end. set_offset==total_sets returns an empty page.

InstructionsResponse.description: All declared instructions, including unexecuted ones with zeros, sorted numerically by access_id. Offset counts rows, not IDs. Same revision as state reads; no historical snapshot retention.

BadRequest.description: Malformed JSON or invalid arguments/configuration; no execution state change.

NotFound.description: No such session (including a deleted or process-restart-lost session).

Conflict.description: State conflict: resource occupied, stale revision, not ready, busy or failed. No requested execution occurs.

Failure.description: Unexpected I/O/model/backend failure. An affected execution session becomes failed; state reads are unavailable. No transactional rollback is promised.
